The Boeing Company is hiring an entry-level software engineer to support mission software development for its Satellite Space Mission Systems team. The role involves developing and maintaining software, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and supporting software quality and program objectives.

Participate in the agile software development lifecycle including planning, reviews, and supporting customer meetings
Debug and resolve issues identified to ensure reliability and efficiency of software products
Support software development, participate in code reviews, and adhere to guidance on software standards and design principles
Execute and document software research and development projects
Assists in developing, establishing, monitoring and improving software processes
